title: N54: Structural gamma decline confirmed — individual stocks -65%, index -53%, amplification 1.04x→1.42x
description: Extended N12/N13 analysis to full 2017-2025 period with 10 stocks. Individual stock gamma declined -65% (0.287→0.099), SPY declined -53% (0.299→0.141). 7/10 stocks statistically significant (p<0.05). But amplification ratio INCREASED from 1.04x to 1.42x, meaning correlation asymmetry intensified. Current 20-stock amplification is 2.3x (SPY 0.229 vs avg stock 0.101). 5/20 stocks now have NEGATIVE gamma. Model selection rule automatically handles this: gamma-based rule switches from GJR to GARCH a
